description: The alternatives the assumption range runs for each fact the drawings don't settle (backend/assumption_range_service.py). Each case is one full calculation with that one input changed. Wall and roof cases take the U-value of a row of the imported AIRAH handbook table (ai/construction_u_values.py), typed in as a U-value only: choosing the handbook construction itself also changes how the calculation treats the wall (found 2026-11-23: Vaucluse, same U 1.9, 24.1 kW typed vs 20.1 kW as the handbook's Brick Veneer), so the range changes the U-value alone until that is reviewed. Edit this file to change what is tried.

unknowns.label: Window glass
unknowns.assumed: The NatHERS default window (aluminium single clear, U 6.7, SHGC 0.57 hinged or 0.70 fixed/sliding): the worst common case, so the load errs high.
unknowns.question: What glazing is specified for the windows and glass doors? A U-value and SHGC for each window type, the window schedule, or the NatHERS certificate's window table.

cases.label: Double-glazed low-e (U 2.9, SHGC 0.40)
cases.basis: Illustrative double-glazed low-e window; replace with the window's WERS rating once known.

unknowns.label: External wall construction
unknowns.assumed: The preliminary wall U-value from the assumption pack.
unknowns.question: What are the external walls made of, and how are they insulated? (For example brick veneer with R2.5 batts, cavity brick, lightweight cladding.)

cases.label: Insulated cavity brick (U 0.5)

change.label: Cavity brick with indoor plaster (with plaster, urea formaldehyde in cavity)

cases.basis: U-value of the AIRAH handbook's "Cavity brick with indoor plaster (with plaster, urea formaldehyde in cavity)" (masonry-walls:cavity-brick-with-indoor-plaster-with-plaster-urea-formaldehyde-in-cavity), typed in.

cases.label: Uninsulated brick veneer (U 1.9)
cases.basis: U-value of the AIRAH handbook's "Brick Veneer" (frame-walls:brick-veneer), typed in.

unknowns.label: Roof and ceiling insulation
unknowns.assumed: The preliminary roof U-value from the assumption pack.
unknowns.question: What is the roof construction and the ceiling insulation (R-value), and is there sarking or foil under the roof?

cases.label: Tiled roof, foil and R2 batts (U 0.27)

change.label: Tiled roof, RFL, R2 bulk insulation, gypsum board

cases.basis: U-value of the AIRAH handbook's "Tiled roof, RFL, R2 bulk insulation, gypsum board" (pitched-roofs:tiled-roof-rfl-r2-bulk-insulation-gypsum-board), typed in.

cases.label: Tiled roof, no insulation (U 1.32)
cases.basis: U-value of the AIRAH handbook's "Tiled roof, gypsum board" (pitched-roofs:tiled-roof-gypsum-board), typed in.

unknowns.label: True north
unknowns.assumed: North as the AI read it from the drawings.
unknowns.question: Which way is true north on the floor plans? A site plan or survey with a north point is enough.

cases.label: North arrow read the wrong way round (180°)
